bug_info.bug_desc: In the old code, the FifoLoadFromFifo state's wait branch (!shaf_rvalid) unconditionally remained in FifoLoadFromFifo and ignored msg_feed_complete. After a stop command, the message feed can be complete before the padding buffer presents another shaf_rvalid block. In that case the FIFO FSM is stuck in FifoLoadFromFifo forever, hash_done_next is never asserted, and the module never reports completion or returns to the idle state. The fix adds a missing state transition out of FifoLoadFromFifo when msg_feed_complete is asserted.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the FifoLoadFromFifo state, when waiting for shaf_rvalid and msg_feed_complete is asserted, transition fifo_st_d to FifoIdle and assert hash_done_next. This allows the stop/process completion to be signalled without waiting indefinitely for a padding-buffer block that will not be produced.
